narr: Monsoonal moisture along with a passing mid level disturbance assisted with afternoon and evening thunderstorm development. A few stronger storms did develop, producing isolated heavy rainfall with localized flash flooding, and large hail.
ev: Chaffee county sheriff reports rock and mudslides along Highway 285 just north of Poncha Pass. CDOT was called out to clear debris.
lsr: CHAFFEE COUNTY SHERIFF REPORTS ROCK AND MUDSLIDES ALONG HIGHWAY 285 JUST NORTH OF PONCHA PASS. CDOT CALLED OUT TO CLEAR DEBRIS.
